caption: A continuous, landscape-format, low-poly 3D city view, with an elevated camera traveling smoothly behind an angular yellow car and looking slightly downward along the road. The fully framed car stays near the lower center, occupying roughly one-fifth of the image width and one-third of its height. Nearby geometry is clear, while distant details become less distinct. A narrow pale-blue sky separates rows of closely spaced multistory cream, blue-gray, orange, and red buildings, cropped along the upper and lateral edges, with repeated dark blue rectangular windows. Gray asphalt fills most of the lower view, divided by dashed yellow center markings and bordered by solid white lines, raised light-gray sidewalks, and intersecting streets with white rectangular crosswalk markings. Cuboid green tree crowns rise on straight brown trunks along both sidewalks. Pale-green ground patches and rectangular tree openings edge the pavement, and small blue rectangular fixtures stand on dark posts near the corners. Smaller trees, pedestrians, street fixtures, and tiny vehicles recede toward the central vanishing point. Bright directional daylight casts hard-edged shadows from buildings, trees, people, and the car, contrasting saturated yellow and green with orange, cream, cool blue-gray, and deep navy shade for a sunny, orderly, game-like atmosphere. The car has a broad dark rear window, a pale-green rectangular roof block, a yellow trunk, two red rectangular rear lights, a small black rectangle at the rear center, and a black lower bumper and underbody; its wheels are largely concealed by the body and rear viewpoint. The car drives along the city streets, slowing, stopping and turning at intersections, while the following camera holds its rear at nearly constant scale. Road markings slide downward toward the foreground, and nearby buildings and trees shift outward through parallax. Block-shaped pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and cross at crosswalks, and other small cars drive on the roads.
